items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: Yeah, I was playing with him... Where did you start in playing with Davy Jones? ... Yeah, I did. In New Orleans? Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was playing with him. Oh yeah? He played saxophone, he played everything. Mm-hmm. He played everything, boy. That's the only man I know could play a lot of French in one, boy. I'm in a place. I'm in a pool. I'm in a place. Mm-hmm. Professor Jones.

Well, did he always stay in New Orleans? What happened to him? He died. He went to California, he died. Mm-hmm, I see. He died in California. Yeah. Well, where did you first play with him? Huh? Where did you start in playing with Davy Jones? Professor Jones? Yeah, I did. In New Orleans? Yeah. What place? Uh, Historia.
Historia. Yeah, come from New York. Yeah, his own band in New York, I think. Yeah. Boy, I tried to have a tone, boy. What kind of saxophones did he play?
